title: Spaceflight-induced transcriptomic and proteomic alterations in human osteoblasts
description: Multi-omics evaluation of osteoblast differentiation, alkaline phosphatase activity, and bone mineral matrix synthesis aboard the International Space Station.
citation: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSD-661), ALSDA/GeneLab

title: Osteocyte mechanosensing suppression in simulated microgravity and bone resorption pathways
description: Fluid shear stress mechanotransduction deficiency in osteocytes under unloading conditions, leading to RANKL up-regulation and osteoclast-mediated bone loss.
citation: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSD-251), NASA Ames Research Center

title: Skeletal muscle atrophy and contractile protein degradation during spaceflight
description: Biopsy analysis of soleus and gastrocnemius muscle fiber atrophy, ubiquitin-proteasome pathway activation, and functional loss across long-duration missions.
citation: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSD-310), GeneLab

title: Mitochondrial metabolic dysfunction and sarcomeric disruption in microgravity muscle wasting
description: Transcriptional profiling of mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation decline and fiber type transition from slow-twitch type I to fast-twitch type II.
citation: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSD-194), Space Biology Program

title: Cardiovascular deconditioning, baroreflex sensitivity, and carotid remodeling in astronauts
description: Cephalad fluid redistribution, autonomic cardiovascular regulation shifts, resting tachycardia, and orthostatic intolerance upon gravitational transition.
citation: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSD-452), ALSDA

title: Orbital spaceflight induces persistent T-cell dysregulation and latent herpesvirus shedding
description: Suppression of cytotoxic T-lymphocyte function, altered Th1/Th2 cytokine balance, and reactivation of Epstein-Barr virus and Varicella-Zoster virus in crew members.
citation: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSD-528), Human Research Program

title: Biological effects of simulated galactic cosmic rays and solar particle events on human DNA
description: Quantification of complex DNA double-strand breaks, gamma-H2AX foci persistence, and chromosomal aberrations induced by high-Z and energy (HZE) ions.
citation: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSD-704), Space Radiation Element
